4. Close the menu, then log in with the correct password
5. Open the account menu. It shows the email and Logout

5. Select the saved card and click Continue. The order summary shows the discount

specs.title: TC-07: Order with a card, from basket to order history

2. Open the basket. A: quantity 2, B: quantity 1, Total 20.97¤
3. Click Checkout, select the saved address and click Continue
4. Select One Day Delivery and click Continue
5. Redeem the coupon of this month. The discount message shows
6. Select the saved card and click Continue. The order summary shows the totals
7. Click Place your order and pay. The confirmation page opens with the order ID
8. The confirmation shows the products, Items, Delivery, Promotion and Total Price
9. The basket is empty and Checkout is disabled
10. Order History shows the order with Total Price 19.86¤ and the two products
